name: Honda CB900F
engine: 902 cc air-cooled DOHC 16-valve inline four, four carbs
intro: Honda's early-80s 900 four. Cam chain tensioners and charging parts need attention on old ones.

add.title: Check the cam chain tensioner
add.instructions: Listen for a rattle at cold start. Check the tensioner and guides for cracks.
add.reason: Worn tensioners and cracked guides let the cam chain slap.
add.src: Honda V4 and inline-four tensioner notes

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Cam chain tensioners
known.what: Honda fours of this era often have tired cam chain tensioners.
